summary: Honor Symbol.match when deciding whether a constructor argument is RegExp-like.

target.notes: IsRegExp first reads value[Symbol.match]; an ordinary object can opt in, and a RegExp instance can opt out of IsRegExp classification.

caveats: A Proxy/getter for Symbol.match may have side effects or throw.
Internal-slot RegExp instances still have special source extraction in the constructor even if Symbol.match is false.

tests.name: ordinary object opts in
tests.input: const x={ [Symbol.match]:true, source:'a', flags:'g' }; const r=new RegExp(x); console.log(r.source,r.flags);

tests.name: regexp can opt out of identity classification
